The object has the general rectangular shape with rounded corners and two circular cutouts typical of a cassette. However, the surface texture is highly anomalous, appearing like felt or coarse fabric rather than smooth plastic. There is a label in the center with illegible, gibberish text that mimics the layout of a cassette label but fails to render readable characters. The background is a light-colored, wood-like surface.
